messages:
aj: quick check — finance just flagged a delayed invoice tied to our reserved queues in us-west1. wondering if this is a tagging/mapping issue on our side or the vendor. should we resize or request a short-term burst? @maria @kevin :wave:

maria: quick snapshot — current reserved pools in us-west1:
- rsv-small-usw1: 12 slots (used 9)
- rsv-med-usw1: 6 slots (used 6)
- rsv-large-usw1: 2 slots (used 2)
No obvious orphan tags, med/large are at capacity. finance delays usually mean vendor invoicing lag, not reservation state. I can request a temporary burst (+10 slots) from vendor if we want to avoid routing changes.

kevin: fyi i opened a quota PR to GCP (waiting on approvals): https://go/repo/pr/4567 — used this command to request the reservation, in case you want to replicate:
```bash
gcloud compute reservations create burst-usw1 --zone=us-west1-b --reservations-sku=a100 --count=10
```
If the quota team stalls, vendor fallback looks faster.

vendor-bot: vendor@rackplus update: ETA for extra A100 racks = 5 business days. Expedited option available (2 business days) with ~+15% fee. Ticket RP-9981 created.

sam: can we also do a short canary reroute to reduce pressure on med/large while this is resolved? propose routing ~20% non-critical traffic to eu-west1 small pool for 24h. quick terraform snippet to propose in the routing PR:
```hcl
resource "redwood_routing" "canary_shift" {
  from = "us-west1"
  to   = "eu-west1"
  percent = 20
  duration = "24h"
}
```
This avoids immediate procurement if we prefer.

maria: that sounds good. i'll prepare the vendor expedite form (RP-9981) if @tony approves. i'll also add invoice_tag=Q2-burst to the new reservation so finance can match it to the expedited charge. :white_check_mark:

ton y: approve :+1:  (note: I'm tony — approving expedite). proceed with vendor expedite and tagging. keep cost notes in the ticket.

aj: thanks all. action items i captured:
- maria: submit vendor expedite (RP-9981) and tag reservations
- kevin: follow up on PR 4567 with quota team
- sam: open routing PR for canary reroute
I'll ping finance to watch for invoice_tag=Q2-burst and will circle back in ~6 hours. :mag:
